observations: Internal-result dominates (24/40), overwhelmingly AUC/R2/delta statistics (statistic=21). Interpretation/question entities whose title or filename names a task (t0NN) are systematic lint false positives -> frontmatter-source-covers (9). truly-orphaned (11) clusters in three benign or doc-local pools: (a) manuscript prose (results-act1.md) restating own AUCs with zero inline anchors (12,17,20,29) - the only real doc-level gaps; (b) author-stipulated thresholds/alphas (0.55, 0.10, 0.05); (c) structural model dims / phase labels (768, 768, Phase 2.5). External-cite numbers all live in paper/topic docs carrying citations. A better check should exempt structural model-dims and stipulated design params, credit title/filename task-IDs and inline (tNNN) mentions as anchors, and focus the genuine signal on narrative/manuscript docs that restate computed statistics without task provenance.
